findings.summary: Rollo Tomassi was formally removed from 21 Studios / The 21 Convention in June 2019 after a documented power struggle with founder Anthony Johnson. He had operated as both speaker and ticket affiliate (~$1,600–2,500/ticket, 120+ attendees/event) from approximately 2013 to 2019.
findings.detail: In June 2019 Tomassi announced he was withdrawing from 21CON Poland and Orlando dates. The 21 Convention LLC issued a public written statement on Medium and DocDroid citing 'conduct unbecoming of a 21 convention alumni speaker' — specifically that Tomassi demanded executive control over speaker selection with threats of departure and was 'deprecating, insulting, and contemptuous' of fellow speakers. Anthony Johnson formally removed him from all future events including The 22 Convention.

findings.summary: Rollo Tomassi wrote the foreword for Richard Cooper's book The Unplugged Alpha (2020, Entrepreneurs in Cars). Confirms a formal collaborative relationship between the two creators.
findings.detail: ISBN 9781777473303. Publisher: Entrepreneurs in Cars (Richard Cooper's entity). Tomassi contributed foreword. Cooper bases his framework on Tomassi's hypergamy theory. Cooper also features Tomassi in premium content on his Entrepreneurs in Cars YouTube channel.

Rollo Tomassi's legal name is George W. Miller, resident of Reno, Nevada. He chose the pen name 'Rollo Tomassi' from the 1997 film L.A. Confidential to protect his family while employed as an art director.
findings.detail: Copyright page of The Rational Male: The Players Handbook (2022, Audible/Counterflow Media) lists George W. Miller as copyright holder. Multiple biographical sources corroborate. Not verified against a government primary source.

findings.summary: Counterflow Media LLC, Reno, Nevada, is the primary corporate entity controlled by George W. Miller (Rollo Tomassi). It is the publisher of record for the Rational Male book series and Audible audiobooks.
findings.detail: Appears as publisher on all five Rational Male volumes and on Amazon Audible audiobook productions. Both 'The Rational Male' and 'Counterflow Media' are described as registered trademarks. Registration numbers not confirmed in USPTO records during this run.

findings.summary: Rollo Tomassi is a recurring guest on Fresh & Fit podcast (Myron Gaines / Walter Weekes). At least three documented joint appearances in 2023. No formal revenue-sharing arrangement found.
findings.detail: Documented Fresh & Fit appearances include: 'The Current State of the Manosphere' (Spotify); 'After Hours w/ Michael Sartain & Rollo Tomassi' (Nov 2023, freshandfit.locals.com); 'After Hours w/ Stirling Cooper, Michael Sartain & Rollo Tomassi' (Nov 2023, X/Locals). Fresh & Fit hosts (Myron Gaines, Walter Weekes) credited Tomassi with foundational influence on their worldview (Patrick Bet-David Valuetainment EP 136).

findings.summary: Rollo Tomassi's direct monetization infrastructure includes: Patreon, Substack (paid tier, launched March 2023), YouTube, and a listing with All American Speakers bureau. He transitioned to full-time authorship circa 2016.
findings.detail: Substack at rationalmale.substack.com and rollotomassi.substack.com launched March 2023, with reported 17K+ free and ~100+ paid subscribers at launch. Patreon at patreon.com/therationalmale (tiered subscription). YouTube ~200K+ subscribers. All American Speakers bureau listing (booking request page exists; fee not publicly listed). These represent Tomassi's primary direct-to-consumer revenue infrastructure outside of book royalties.

findings.summary: Negative search results across EDGAR, FEC, PPP, CourtListener, and OpenSanctions for Rollo Tomassi / George W. Miller / Counterflow Media LLC. No enforcement actions, litigation, political contributions, or public financial filings found.
findings.detail: No FTC/FCC complaints found. No state AG actions found. No PACER/CourtListener case. No EDGAR filing. No FEC donations from George Miller in Nevada. No PPP loan under Counterflow Media or George Miller. No sanctions or PEP designation. No offshore entity record. The absence of financial regulatory footprint is consistent with a private LLC author/media business not subject to public financial disclosure.

findings.detail: Tomassi connections without going through Tate: (a) Anthony Dream Johnson/21 Studios — recurring paid speaker and ticket affiliate 2013-2019, removed after power struggle; (b) Myron Gaines/Fresh&Fit — recurring guest, 3+ documented 2023 appearances; (c) Patrick Bet-David — PBD Podcast EP124 appearance; (d) Michael Sartain — co-hosts Access Vegas program; (e) Richard Cooper — wrote foreword for The Unplugged Alpha (2020); (f) Stirling Cooper — joint Fresh&Fit appearance Nov 2023.
